Genome lineage inspector

Genome color shows the relative normalized R/G/B gene coefficients, not measured optical wavelength. Each genome is SHA-256-marked; source trust requires keeping the original signed/checksummed records.

Same seeded workloads, assumed service costs. Objective = 1000 × coverage − 1.1 × worker-seconds − 0.04 × duplicates − 1.4 × births.


Monochrome and achromatic emergence
The separate genetic study uses artificial selection pressures. Monochromatic means one channel reaches ≥ 92% normalized weight; achromatic means max minus min RGB is ≤ 0.025. Neither phenomenon is biological genetics.
Each curve shows the best individual's gene values over 48 generations.

Boundaries & scientific status
Original v0.5 leaky integrate-and-fire neuron sources, v0.6 photoreceptor and v0.7 quaternary source are locked in legacy/. Numerical diffusion and extinction are computed on synthetic grid data. No internet access, autonomous spawning of external processes, account access, financial transaction, mining, motor control, or live optical measurements occur.
